[".venv/bin/python", "-c", "import json,re,math
from pathlib import Path
from tiny_perceptron.retrieval import call_tool
from tiny_perceptron.data import ByteTokenizer
r=json.loads(Path('docs/course-experiments/results/tools.json').read_text())['results'];t=ByteTokenizer();rows=[]
for s in r['samples']:
 calls=[e for e in s['trace'] if e.get('executed')];q=s['question'];m=re.fullmatch(r'CALC:(add|multiply)\((\d+),(\d+)\)',q);items=[]
 for e in s['trace']:
  g=e['generation']['samples'][0];ids=g['generated_ids'];items.append({'text':g['generated'],'ids_match':t.decode(ids)==g['generated'],'eos':ids[-1]==t.eos_id,'invalid_control_ids':[i for i in ids[:-1] if i<8]})
 ok=[]
 for e in calls:
  a=json.loads(e['generation']['samples'][0]['generated']);expected={'name':m[1],'arguments':{'a':int(m[2]),'b':int(m[3])}};value=call_tool(a);ok.append({'request_matches':a==expected,'result_matches_recomputed':value==e['tool_result'],'finite':math.isfinite(value)})
 rows.append({'question':q,'call_count':len(calls),'call_checks':ok,'generations':items})
print(json.dumps({'episodes':len(rows),'arithmetic':sum(x['question'].startswith('CALC:') for x in rows),'copy':sum(x['question'].startswith('COPY:') for x in rows),'actual_calls':sum(x['call_count'] for x in rows),'all_arithmetic_single_call':all(x['call_count']==1 for x in rows if x['question'].startswith('CALC:')),'all_copy_no_call':all(x['call_count']==0 for x in rows if x['question'].startswith('COPY:')),'all_call_match_finite':all(all(c.values()) for x in rows for c in x['call_checks']),'all_ids_match':all(g['ids_match'] for x in rows for g in x['generations']),'rows':rows,'scope':'historical raw generation/execution fields and deterministic call_tool, not new model'},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))"]
